main: ^* Balisar exhales slowly, like trying to bury a memory.
^* Balisar’s grip tightens as he holds himself back.
^* A bitter silence clings to the air between you.
^* He grips his weapon like it’s the only thing holding him together.
^* Rain would’ve suited this moment. Instead, silence falls like ash.
^* His stance is firm—but every step echoes hesitation.
